en: I figured that.
That's right, you already know how fearsome they are. Yes, they certainly don't need Yama-oroshi's size to satisfy their hunger for human flesh...
If you happen upon a bear, you might be tempted to run from it, but that's not the best idea. They will always give chase, and they can outrun any man.
You're better off calmly dodging their attacks until they give up. Or shooting them, of course.
If you're going to shoot though, you should know that your very life depends on dropping it with just one bullet. Nothing is more dangerous than an injured bear.
I don't expect you to know where a bear's heart is. Aim for its head.
I'll remember that.
Good. Now, then. We've set traps at all the sites in this area.
Now we just wait until they are sprung. And you can use any spare traps as you see fit.
It appears you're getting the hang of things. Let's look around for the next trap site.
By the way, watch your health while you're on the mountain. You need to eat food to keep up your strength, and if things start looking bad, don't push your luck.
You really don't want to be surviving solely on the meat of whatever you hunt, since that's never a sure thing.
Always, always, always pack food for your trips up the mountain.
I'll do that.
There! We got ourselves a rabbit.
See, that's all there is to it⑬suit the trap to the game.
I getcha.
Well, you're a proper rookie hunter now, so I'll treat you as such.
From now on, you do the prepwork and hunt your own food. You feel okay with that?
Alright wit' me.
Good. Let's make our way down and bring this rabbit to Baba.
Fine idea.
Gwroooaaar!
That roar...!
Is it Yama-oroshi!?
Saejima, run. I'll hold him off.
What're ya talkin' about? Ya can't even shoot right now. I'll deal with the beast. Just stick near me while I do.
Listen. You can't outrun or kill him, so don't even try. Just concentrate on fending him off.
Fine. Just keep yerself safe, Okudera-han!
Nothin' caught in this one.
Don't be discouraged, Saejima. Successful hunting doesn't come easily.
*sigh* Nothin' caught yet.
That's just how it goes sometimes. No need to lament every empty trap.
Yes! Got it.
Well done. That's how you hunt.
Now collect what you can from the kill.
Walk up to the animal you shot to collect parts of its carcass.
Good. You've collected what you can.
Don't waste those items... Never forget that you took an animal's life to get them.
Yeah. I understand.
Meat taken from carcasses is precious, and some animal parts can restore health. At the very least, they can fetch good prices. Don't forget to collect them!

Always keep an eye on your health. If it drops to
zero, all the items and mission progress you made
during your current mountain outing will be lost.
(Gotta give this deer meat to Nishina's wife. Better put it in my Valuables to keep it safe.)
So do you want to keep hunting, or go back to the village? Your call.
I'm fine either way.
Good. Now that that's done, we should go. Animals won't come near it if there are people around. You should always go somewhere else before looping back around to check your traps.
You never know what can happen. Game might get snared even while you're walking around other trap sites. Then again, it might not. Set traps at good sites, and be patient.
It should go without saying, but make sure you actually collect trapped game.
We're hunters, not indiscriminate killers. Do you understand that?
Any traps you set will appear on the map. To recover them, along with any game that was caught, simply walk up to the trap sites.

1. Use different traps for different game.
2. Find trap sites and set traps at those spots.
3. After a trap is set, leave it alone.
4. Always collect trapped game.
Good. Why don't we look for some more trap sites?
Why are you leaving? We haven't spotted any deer yet.
Saejima, we shouldn't go any further than this. We don't want to run into Yama-oroshi.
(Let's see what Yamaura-san's memo says.)
"Kiss Kiss" is a fashion magazine aimed at pre-teens and teens.
The interviewer will be Kotani-san. She's an old, unmarried career woman. She's nice enough, but is very particular about professionalism.
The interview will consist of questions from readers asking for advice. These will mostly be about love and relationships.
Try to give responses that the readers will be able to relate to. Remember, if you want to be a popular idol you have to appeal to the young female audience as well.
For this kind of interview, it's also important to make a favorable impression on the interviewer. Their experience with you will affect the tone of the article they write.
(Okay, so this is what I have to keep in mind for the interview.)
(I have to be relatable to pre-teen and teen girls.)
(And Kotani-san is very particular about professionalism.)
(All right. Got it!)
Hello. I'm here for an interview with Haruka-chan.
(Oh! The interviewer is here.)
Hello. I'm Kotani from "Kiss Kiss." It's very nice to meet you, Haruka-chan.
You as well! Thank you very much for coming.
I imagine your manager has already explained everything to you. You are aware of what today's interview is about?
What's the matter? Did your manager have you do this interview with no preparation at all?
Oh, that will not do. I gave your manager the particulars beforehand for a reason.
Hmph. Well. I will explain again. We'd like you to give our readers advice about the relationship problems they've written in about.
I was told it would be questions from readers asking for relationship advice.
Yes, good. So you are prepared.
Now, then. Girls from middle school and high school have written in, asking for your advice on their relationship troubles. Just answer the way you think is best.
And remember, our readers will be able to take heart if they see that even a cute idol like yourself has been through some of the same things they have.
Let's see. It's about the Princess League, right?
No, that's not it at all. How odd. Is that what your manager told you?
I understand you are currently appearing on the Princess League, but today's interview is about answering reader's love and relationship questions.
Oh, that will not do at all. I gave your manager the particulars beforehand for a reason.
Well, never mind. I'll assume it was an oversight.
Let's see. Is it about my life as an idol?
No, that's not it. How odd. Is that what your manager told you?
I'm sure our readers are interested in your idol life, but today's interview is about answering reader's questions about relationships.
Now, on to the questions. Remember, these are middle school and high school aged girls like you, so just answer the way you normally would.
Okay, here we go. The first question is from Mina-chan in Tokyo. She's a middle school student.
She writes, "My friend and I both like the same boy. What would you do if you were in my shoes?"
Hm. I guess that was a tough one. But you have to say something, or I won't have anything to write in the article.
I really apologize.
Oh. Well. Let's just move on to the next question, I suppose.
I would give up and let my friend have him. Friendship is more important to me than romance.
But what if you really, really like this boy? And do friendships last all that long, anyway? Who knows, this relationship could even lead to marriage!
Maybe, but I still couldn't betray my friend. That just wouldn't be me.
I see. But if you keep choosing friendship over romance, you might miss your chance to ever get married at all. Like I did.
But you're still young, Kotani-san. You have plenty of time!
Hehe. Well, aren't you sweet? I think I might be becoming a new fan of yours!
I would go after the boy myself and not worry about my friend. I have to follow my own heart.
Hmm. That makes you sound a little love-hungry, I'd say. Do you think your agency would be okay with you saying that?
I don't know. It's just how I honestly feel.
Hmm. Maybe that's just how young people these days think. I suppose too much holding back doesn't help anyone find love.
However, I'm not sure an answer like that will make you very popular with our readers.
I would ask my friend to give up and let me have him.
Really!? Do you think your friend would even agree to do that? Wouldn't it ruin your friendship?
Well, if I sincerely explain how I feel, I think she might understand.
I suppose if she wasn't a very assertive girl, she might give him up for you. But wouldn't you feel bad?
After all, a cute girl like you could get any boy you wanted. Wouldn't you be better off placing more value on your friendships?
Wow. To tell you the truth, my image of you has changed after this.
Oh. I'm sorry.
Anyway, here's the next question. It's from Airi-chan, in Gifu Prefecture.
"My boyfriend is shy. We've been going out for six months, but we've still never kissed. Some of my friends have gone further in less time. What do I do?"
Can't think of a good answer? I won't have anything to put in my article.
Hmph. I suppose just try to do better on the next one.
You should be the one to kiss him. If he's shy, there's no telling how long you'll have to wait before he does.
Oh my! You're quite bold, aren't you, Haruka-chan?
I just believe that if you want something to happen, sometimes the best thing to do is make it happen yourself.
Ah. I like your way of thinking. It's very refreshing.
But doesn't it take a lot of courage for a girl to make the first move?
Maybe so. But sometimes a girl just needs to be brave.
That's a pretty brazen thing for an idol to say. I imagine the reactions will be mixed, but I'll try to give it a favorable slant.
You should keep waiting. That's not the kind of thing you should hurry. And besides, what does it matter what other people are doing?
I can understand the feeling of not wanting to fall behind the other girls. Being worried your friends are going to make fun of you is quite distressing.
But if you really like him, then you should wait for it to happen naturally. Why worry about what other girls might say?
What a very mature and well-considered answer. It sounds like you'd make someone a very good girlfriend.
I know it's hard not to succumb to peer pressure, but I bet you've helped many of our readers find courage with that answer.
How about trying to set the mood to entice him to kiss you?
Set the mood how?
For example, you could touch his arm or his knee, cuddle in close, turn your face toward his, and close your eyes.
Hold on! That sounds a little like what a hostess bar girl would do! Are you really recommending that to our readers?
Oh, I'm sorry. Is that bad?
Well, not necessarily. It's just that it was such an unexpected answer. That's great for my article, though!
All right, here's the last question. It's a pretty serious one. It's from Apple-chan, in Tochigi Prefecture.
"My friend has been seeing her teacher, who is married with children. I keep telling her she should break it off with him, but she just won't listen."
Oh, come on! What am I supposed to put in my article if you don't say anything?
If you didn't want to do this interview, why didn't you just say so? I'd prefer you didn't waste my time.
Now I'll have no choice but to write a bland article. I don't want to hear any complaints later!
It's a difficult situation, isn't it? But I really hoped you'd say something to help our reader.
Hmph. Well, if you're not sure what to say, I suppose there's nothing I can do.
If you care about your friend, the only thing you can do is keep telling her to stop seeing him. No one wins in that kind of relationship.
Yes, but the friend is obviously thinking with her heart and not her head. Do you think she'll take heed?
Plus, she might not have even known he was married until after she had already fallen in love with him. Now, she just can't bear to leave.
Maybe, but once she does know, she has to break up with him. That kind of relationship will only bring pain to everyone involved.
Well, aren't you the moral one! But your answer does makes a lot of sense.
Hm. Maybe I should break up with my man, too.
Um, sorry?
Oh, nothing! I was just thinking out loud.
If she refuses to listen to you, then all you can do is end your friendship with her.
Really? Just like that?
